story: The first tree (Christmas Eve 1931, during the Depression) was a 20-foot fir that construction workers paid for themselves and decorated with cranberries, paper garlands and tin cans; the first official tree came in 1933.

es.caption:
Me pagaron los obreros. ¿Qué monumento debería contar su historia ahora? 👇

En la Nochebuena de 1931, en plena Gran Depresión, los obreros que construían el Rockefeller Center juntaron dinero para un abeto de seis metros. Lo decoraron con arándanos, guirnaldas de papel y latas. El primer árbol oficial llegó en 1933.

Cada monumento tiene una historia así. Urban Tales te la cuenta mientras caminas. Link en la bio.

en.caption:
Paid for by workers. Which landmark should tell its story next? 👇

On Christmas Eve 1931, deep in the Great Depression, the men building Rockefeller Center pooled their money for a twenty-foot fir. They decorated it with cranberries, paper garlands and tin cans. The first official tree followed in 1933.

Every landmark has a story like this. Urban Tales plays them as you walk past. Link in bio.
